common_draft_available: There is unsaved input. Restore it?
common_draft_read_only: You cannot edit here right now, so the input cannot be restored. It stays in this browser until you discard it.
common_connection_lost: Can't reach the server. Checking until it's back. Nothing you typed is discarded.
common_session_expired: You've been signed out. What you typed is still in this window. Sign in again in a new tab, then come back here and try again.
common_session_sign_in: Sign in in a new tab
common_server_error: The server could not handle the request. If it keeps happening, give your administrator request ID {requestId}.
common_error_network: The server could not be reached. Check the connection and try again.
common_error_not_found: It doesn't exist or you can't see it.
common_error_invalid_state: This can't be done right now. Reload and try again.
common_error_archived: You cannot write to an archived item.
common_error_account_changed: Not applied: you are now signed in with a different account than the one this window was opened with. Reloading for that account.
common_discard_description: If you close now, the changes you made here will be lost.
common_error_too_large: What you sent is too large. Make it smaller and try again.
common_conflict_hint: Nothing has been saved. Your input is kept. Choose the value to save for each field.
common_conflict_repeated: The content changed again during review. Your input is kept. Please choose again.
common_conflict_both: Both sides changed this field differently. Choose your input or the latest server value.
common_conflict_mine_only: You changed this field. Your input is selected.
common_conflict_server_changes: {count} fields changed by others (keep server values)
common_conflict_blocked: You cannot save right now. Your input is kept.
common_conflict_equal: Your input matches the latest server values.
common_conflict_looks_same: These values look the same but differ when saved (such as trailing spaces or invisible characters).
